svg.text: K5b P0 — the one turning, heated position under the column
The pot turns on a loose pin-toothed ring; the tool hangs still from the crosshead. No shaft in the food, no tool drive.
P0: 3 kW induction · 0–500 rpm · 20 Nm up to 120 rpm
400 W servo + pinion on one of three PEEK rollers
pot skirt drops into the ring, 2 mm above the glass
Ankarsrum principle: bowl turns, tool stands still
Section and plan of the turning ring
The pot turns, the scraper stands: every part of
the floor and wall passes the blade once a turn.
Dough is squeezed under the fixed roller and
turned back by the scraper (Ankarsrum practice).
The bowl turns, the fixed spiral track walks each
portion outward; rolling makes it round.
250 rpm on a rough floor, water spray, a fixed
deflector stops the charge from co-rotating.

g.text: 1/3 Heat on: the coil under the glass heats the pot, which stands 2 mm above the glass in the turning ring
2/3 Turning: one servo drives one roller; the ring's pin teeth carry the pot round; the tool on the crosshead stands still
3/3 Same position, other tools: scraper, kneading roller, spiral guide, knurled liner, plate during plating
